summary: Targeted re-test of iteration_6 MEDIUM bug: RESTORE PURCHASES confirmation is now visible on the Pigeons screen via a top-level Text with data-testid='restore-msg' rendered outside the purchase sheet. Verified fix + full regression of store flows.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: doRestore now writes to a dedicated restoreMsg state and the <Text testID='restore-msg'> is rendered directly below the restore-purchases Pressable, outside the {sheet && ...} block. Purchase-sheet remains closed during restore.

Note: The 'sheet-error' msg state remains in place for purchase failures; the two concerns are now cleanly separated. Consider clearing restoreMsg on subsequent taps of unlock/select to prevent a stale message lingering while the user interacts with the rest of the screen (minor UX polish, non-blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_7 verified at 430x920. Verified flows: (1) Fresh state -> RESTORE PURCHASES shows visible 'NOTHING TO RESTORE' below button, purchase-sheet NOT open. (2) DEV sim-success on locked pigeon (roadman) -> RESTORE shows 'RESTORED 1 PURCHASE'. (3) Persistence across reload confirmed: previously purchased pigeon remains unlocked and restore count = 1. (4) unlock-all-button + sim-success -> unlock-all-button hides and all 5 premium pigeons show as unlocked (no preview-unlock button). (5) 733T leet code entered via open-code-button -> after dismissing leet-done modal, leet-badge visible, all pigeons usable, but restore-msg correctly reports 'NOTHING TO RESTORE' (leet entitlement is separate from purchases as designed). MenuScreen button testID is 'pigeons-button' (not 'menu-pigeons').
rca of the issue: Previous fix: PigeonsScreen.js added a dedicated `restoreMsg` state and rendered <Text testID='restore-msg' style={styles.restoreMsg}>{restoreMsg}</Text> immediately after the RESTORE PURCHASES Pressable, outside the conditional purchase-sheet overlay. Confirmed rendered and visible in DOM after tapping restore-purchases.
